remarks: Please submit all offers by Tuesday, Feb. 10th at 6pm. Bring your Pinterest Albums to reality in this charming ranch in the coveted Wolfpit neighborhood! This gem is the perfect condo alternative you've been searching for! While the home does need some TLC, it offers endless potential for those looking to put their personal touch on it. With three cozy bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with sliders leading to your own private back deck, she truly is a must-see. The open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area creates an inviting space for gatherings and relaxation. Plus, you'll love the convenience of having Stew Leonard's just across the street for all your grocery needs! With its prime location, commuting is a breeze. Don't miss out on this delightful home!
